To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We have developed a wafer level packaging technology for MEMS resonator components based on silicon interposers with copper filled through silicon vias (TSVs) and wafer to cap wafer bonding.
A MEMS package based wafer level hermetic sealing of quartz resonator components was developed and fabricated.
the presented MEMS package is suitable for wafer level packaging and that the getter appears to be efficient for vacuum sealing of the MEMS devices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an innovative packaging technology for MEMS resonator components.

the development of a wafer level MEMS packaging concept which is based on a hermetic sealing of the resonator component by wafer to waffer bonding of a cap wafer onto an interposer wafer with through silicon vias TSVs.
the development of a new MEMS packaging concept for resonator components based on wafer level hermetic sealing using TSV interposers and cap wafers with deep cavities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the developed fabrication process is suitable for hermetic wafer level sealing of MEMS components and that further optimization of getter deposition and sealing processes is necessary.
the used process flow is capable of producing MEMS packages with hermeticity of 0.1 mbara and above.
the presented wafer to waffer bonding process scheme for MEMS components in hermetic packages can be successfully applied at 200 mm wafers level.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented MEMS packaging process is capable of hermetically sealing MEMS components in wafer level and that this packaging technology is well suited for MEMS components requiring vacuum sealing.
the described processes are suitable to be used for the hermetic packaging of MEMS resonators at wafer level and the described package is able to provide a hermetic sealing of the MEMS resonators.
we were able to develop a process flow for the fabrication of hermetic wafer level packages for MEMS devices using TSV and wafer to wafers bonding technologies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a high yield wafer level packaging process for MEMS resonator components is achievable using wafer level TSV technology.
wafer to waffer bonding of MEMS components with hermetic seal is possible and can be performed on 200 mm wafers using adapted processes.
the presented fabrication scheme is a promising approach for the hermetic packaging of resonator devices.
